headline: Account 2 is live. 87 initials yesterday, more than double Tuesday and the highest since July.

sections.title: Do today
sections.text: Richie's call is tomorrow and it is the only new cash still reachable this month, so send the pre call proof today. Doctrine puts proof in the sequence before every anchor call, and the one deal that died on proof died exactly there. Then log the four open outcomes, Robert, luca, Evan and Joshua Haber, with four working days left. Six replies are still untagged: Alexander Cano, Jack trades, Leppan, Alexandra flame, Nick sanders and Matthew Chamberlin.

sections.title: Watch
sections.text: What account 2 replies do. Sends doubled yesterday but replies trail initials by about four days, so the first honest read lands Monday. The account needs 150 sends of its own before any per account verdict counts.
